title: Text: DET Greg Garno ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Has the schedule been finalized?
I’m thinking of tweeting something like, “Just booked a hotel room for Cincinnati on July 23 and I’m already nervous”
Something of that ilk
I don’t know if it’s final. I just saw it recently
I heard about this Sports betting thing last week but I didn’t think it was going to be announced for a bit
I saw someone broke the news this morning, though so maybe that pushed the timeline up
And that they’re going to be doing the same thing at LCA
Yeah, I figured if it happened for the Tigers it would happen for the wings. No one has told me to announce anything so I assume I’m leaving it alone
Now you can buy a ticket to the Tigers game and get your money back by betting against them:
Are you going there tomorrow?
Nah, no need for me to be there as of right now.
Who’s gonna tweet
Me
From my house
With stuff they send to you
Yeah, Brent will be on the field
Ew
Wow that was mean
It just bothers me thinking about Brent roaming the field
